judgment: It is good to hold firm.
image: Earth above the marsh: Coming Near.
So the noble one teaches, and thinks, without end,
shelters and guards the people without bound.
lines: They come near in shared feeling.
They come near in shared feeling.
Already grieving over it — no harm.

notes.name_en: 臨 is approaching and looking down on; 'Coming Near', not Wilhelm's 'Approach'.
notes.L1: 咸臨: 咸 mutual feeling (cf. 31), coming near in shared feeling.
